# LangChain 1.4.3: Bedrock Mantle in init_chat_model, GPT-6 structured-output recognition, create_agent repairs invalid tool calls

LangChain Verified @LangChainAI

LangChain shipped `langchain==1.4.3` on 2026-09-28 (on PyPI): `init_chat_model` supports AWS Bedrock Mantle chat models via langchain-aws Mantle interfaces; recognizes GPT-6 structured output without profiles; `create_agent` emits error `ToolMessage` s for invalid tool calls missing results on replay; sanitizes cache settings for fallback models. Key PRs: #40837, #40844, #40530, #40886 vs 1.4.2.

## Key Takeaways

- ✓ langchain==1.4.3 on PyPI (2026-09-28)
- ✓ init_chat_model + Bedrock Mantle (#40837) via langchain-aws Mantle chat wrappers
- ✓ GPT-6 structured output recognized without profiles (#40844)
- ✓ create_agent repairs invalid tool calls with error ToolMessages (#40530); sanitize fallback cache settings (#40886)

Anthropic's AI Update Brings Smarter, Faster Conversations | The Neural Feed

# Anthropic's AI Update Brings Smarter, Faster Conversations

 LangChain Releases October 13, 2026 

⚡ Your AI chats just got better at remembering context and switching topics.

Deep Dive

The langchain-anthropic Python package has moved from version 1.7.5 to 1.7.6. The changelog shows the 1.7.6 release, a refresh of model profile data, and a change declaring mid-conversation support in model profiles across core, anthropic, and openai. It also bumps dependencies: langgraph-sdk from 0.4.4 to 0.4.6 and from 0.4.2 to 0.4.4, and urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0.

Key Points

- Anthropic's Claude AI can now remember more of your conversation and handle topic changes better.
- The update also fixes behind-the-scenes issues to make AI apps more stable and secure.
- You'll experience fewer frustrating moments where the AI forgets what you just said.

### Why It Matters

Better AI memory means less repetition and more natural, helpful conversations in your daily tasks.
